children.text: Northbridge Router was faster than Southbridge Router in the indoor trial.
Southbridge Router was faster than Northbridge Router in the outdoor trial.

root_proposition.text: Northbridge Router was faster than Southbridge Router in the indoor trial, while the outdoor trial reversed that ordering.

sources.content: Indoor trial median transfer time: Northbridge Router 81 ms; Southbridge Router 96 ms.
Outdoor trial median transfer time: Southbridge Router 104 ms; Northbridge Router 117 ms.
Northbridge Router indoor antenna tuning reduced packet setup time.
Southbridge Router outdoor enclosure passed rain testing.
Both routers support WPA3 enterprise authentication.
